meta.requirement: Explore Wolvendom (1%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: The Stash
start.text:
''A man in a travel-worn coat is pacing a clearing, squinting at a scrap of paper and then at the trees, then back at the paper. He notices you and his face lights up.''

Adventurer: You! You look like someone who can keep a secret. ''lowers his voice to a stage whisper'' There is treasure out here. Real treasure. Buried somewhere in these woods. I have the markings, I just need a second pair of hands.

''He grins.''

Adventurer: Help me dig it up and I will split it with you. Fifty fifty. What do you say?

Fifty_percent__Im_in.text:
Adventurer: ''claps his hands together'' Excellent! Knew I had a good feeling about you.

''He paces along a mossy ridge, comparing his scrap of paper to the rock face, until he stops short in front of a slab of weathered stone.''

Adventurer: Here. This is it. But it is sealed somehow. ''runs a hand over the surface'' There is some kind of old mechanism set into the wall. Crystals. See if you can make sense of it, I am no good with puzzles.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Search Wolvendom for the adventurer's hidden stash

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Inspect Ancient Puzzle

ancient_puzzle.title: 🗿 Ancient Puzzle
ancient_puzzle.text:
''Worn glyphs ring seven dim crystals set into the stone. They flicker as your fingers hover over them.''

Complete the lightsout puzzle within 3 minutes to proceed. You can use the solver below to help you finish it

continues.label: Do /rpg after you finished the puzzle, then click on Enter the Secret Passage. Defeat 2 [[Hydro Slime]]s

beat_hydroslimes.text:
''The slimes burst apart in a spray of water. The passage is quiet again.''

Adventurer: ''breathing hard'' Right. Right. No more surprises. The treasure. It has to be just inside.

''He waves you toward the dark opening.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Claim the stash inside the passage

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Open the Stash

open_stash.text:
''A few paces in, your torchlight catches on a small iron lockbox tucked into a niche. The adventurer practically dives for it, prying the lid open with both thumbs.''

''Inside, rattling around the bottom, is a thin scatter of coins.''

Adventurer: ''long pause'' ...Twenty Silver. ''picks one up, turns it over, sets it back down'' The map said treasure. This is a bad night's tips.

''He snaps the lockbox shut and tucks it under his arm.''

Adventurer: I am keeping this. Not for me. I dragged you out here on a bad map and I intend to make that right.

wutnow.text:
''The adventurer dusts off his coat and looks at you with something more serious than before.''

Adventurer: Look. I dragged you out here on a bad map and a worse promise. That does not sit right with me. ''he straightens'' Between us, I am not exactly a beginner at this. I have some standing back in the city. People who owe me favours.

''He starts back toward the passage mouth.''

Adventurer: Let me make this right properly. Come with me to Mondstadt. I know exactly who to talk to.

choices.label: Go with him to Mondstadt City

go_le_mond.text:
Adventurer: Good. Meet me at the city. I will have a word ahead of you.

''He sets off down the trail at a brisk pace, leaving you to make your own way back to Mondstadt City.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Travel to Mondstadt City with the adventurer

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt) and click on Meet the Adventurer's Contact

meet_adv.text:
''The adventurer is waiting near the city storehouse, and he is not alone. Beside him stands a poised woman in blue and white, the crest of the Knights of Favonius at her shoulder.''

Adventurer: There you are. ''gestures between you'' This is the friend who bailed me out. Friend, this is Jean, Acting Grand Master.

Jean: ''inclines her head'' I heard the whole story. I am sorry you were led on a chase through Wolvendom for a box of pocket change. ''a small, genuine smile'' Let me at least make your travels a little easier.

Jean: Extra space at the city storehouse is not given out lightly. There is a storage fee of one thousand Silver.

Adventurer: ''steps forward, sheepish but determined'' Wait. I still have the twenty Silver from that wretched lockbox. Put it toward the fee.

Jean: ''nods'' That brings what you owe down to nine hundred eighty Silver. Pay thatneed to gather the Silver first, and the extra storage is yours.

choices.label: I need to gather the Silver first

gather_silv.text:
Jean: ''patient'' The offer stands whenever you are ready. Come back with nine hundred eighty Silver and we will sort out your allotment at the storehouse.

Adventurer: ''quietly'' Sorry again about the map. At least the storage is real.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Pay Jean 980 Silver for the storage upgrade in Mondstadt City

pay_silb.text: Jean: ''accepts the Silver'' Consider it done. Your allotment at the storehouse has been expanded. You will be able to keep far more on hand from now on.

stash_secured.title: Stash Secured
stash_secured.text:
Jean: Think nothing of it. ''to the adventurer'' And you. Next time, verify the map before you recruit help.

Adventurer: ''sheepish'' Noted, Acting Grand Master.

''Jean gives you a parting nod and returns to her duties. The adventurer claps you on the shoulder and heads off, already muttering about a better lead he has heard about.''
